title: MV Looking to have my battle status look similar to that of 'Hylics 2'... Can anyone point me in the right direction?

posts.author: Sayleph
posts.body:
Hello, thanks for reading. This is my first post on here so forgive me if I mess anything up.
I've been
very
inspired by 'Hylics 2' and it pushed me to work on a new RPG, and I want to borrow some of the battle elements from the game. I will name them below.
- Front view animations play when using skills/items that target the user
- Status effects have animations that play over enemies and actor's faces
- Enemy health shown with a counter
The plugins I currently use (that matter) are as follows:
- Yanfly's Core
- Yanfly's BattleEngineCore
This is for RPGMMV, btw

posts.author: alieno
posts.body: Hi Sayleph! Just fyi, Hylics 2 was made in Unity, while Hylics 1 was made in RPGMaker

posts.author: LowrellLovelace
posts.body:
Sayleph said:
- Front view animations play when using skills/items that target the user
Click to expand...
It's a lot harder to achieve what you want in front view since there's no character sprites (I think). Thus, what most people do is shift the side view into looking like front view just with the actors at the bottom of the screen with plugins.
Yanfly's BattleEngineCore is able to do just that, shift the actors to the bottom.
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/threads/is-there-any-way-to-have-actors-on-the-bottom-of-the-battle-screen-rather-than-the-side.120470/

Hello!  I've been doing similiar things for a while, it is a fair bit of work, especially the animation, i'll give you a basic round down of everything you need, to modify anything in the battle hud i reccomend MOG's battluhud plugin, and also check some of their other hud plugins if you need something more specific, for the first person animations i recommend this video
, altough, it doesen't cover it if you need to make "bigger" animations, like bigger hands or maybe both hands on the screen, since rpg maker mv only supports 192x192 cell sprite size, so if you want something bigger you'll have to do something like felvidek, where one frame of an hand for example is composed of multiple cells of itself, cropped, and then re alligned in engine (this is the frustrating part)
